subject: [PATCH v8 04/30] powerpc: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch adds PMD (Page Middle Directory) swap-exclusive helpers for the PowerPC architecture. The goal is to enable keeping a PMD-mapped anonymous THP (Transparent Huge Page) mapped across a swap round-trip, which requires the PG_anon_exclusive flag to survive in a swap PMD. The patch introduces three new macros: pmd_swp_mkexclusive, pmd_swp_exclusive, and pmd_swp_clear_exclusive, which wrap the existing PTE (Page Table Entry) helpers.
